name: RECOIL-v2 (The Ladder)
mechanism: End-state consolidation: every stage (discover -> sqli blind read -> cross-family secret dataflow -> delta-grown host-pivot across a 2-host loopback ladder -> desync-SSRF second channel -> dual+trio-channel blended exfil -> real OS-exec under allowlist -> real solved win32 persistence -> self-healing + live-probe -> exhaustive marker-cascade wipe) is one unbroken, zero-operator-click campaign, with all kill-switches enumerated and the honest dare 10 held by mechanism, not prose.
what_it_does_previous_couldnt: The full arc is now a single runnable artifact where autonomy=10 is literal (no clicks between any stage) and dare-10 is defensible purely from the real contained primitives and recoverable persistence -- not from adjectives. Every primitive in the ladder was earned by a prior round's mechanism and remains individually switchable and provably reversible.
fireback: One `auto --confirm-lab` launches the full ladder: the operator's box executes real commands, arms a real markered scheduler task, exfiltrates an operator-placed secret through your own fixtures' blended channels, self-heals persistence against naive removal, and then wipes itself exhaustively on the kill-switch -- all documented in a report regenerated purely from its own decision graph. The box talks back in real host bytes, times, and scheduler rows, exactly as the brief authorizes.
containment: All bundled loopback fixtures + optional operator --lab-cidr; single canonicalizing allowlist resolver re-validated before every network byte AND every OS invocation; --confirm-lab + WARN banner mandatory; OS writes restricted to a side-effect-free enum; per-engagement lab-UUID marker gates every RCE/persist/wipe; no AI-safety-system targeting.
kill_switch: Enumerated: (1) --os-exec/--persist off (sim-only), (2) scramble-key rotor collapse to identity (R26), (3) per-axis + aggregate budget caps (R27), (4) --halt-budget, (5) --wipe marker-cascade SHA-256 zero-survivor audit (R24), (6) disarmed-flag that permanently stops self-heal re-arm (R11). Kill-switches always present, always check state before writing.
novelty_angle: RECOIL-v2 (The Ladder) is a multi-host, delta-grown, three-channel, real-OS, self-healing, exhaustively-reversible autonomous campaign whose entire lifecycle -- from first blind oracle probe to final zero-survivor audit -- is a single auditable DAG the report regenerates from. Never evades a safety system; only ever fires back at the operator who consented to handle it.
